about.title: What is Simpulo?
about.intro: Simpulo matches people, not accommodation. Share a place – and find your people.
about.houses: A House on Simpulo is a shared place – a villa, an apartment, a chalet – opened by one host for two to six people, from a long weekend to a few months. The host says what the House is about: training, building, creating, slowing down. You ask to join, the host says yes, and the House sorts out the rest together.
about.people: No hostel dorms, no strangers you never spoke to. Just people who want the same kind of trip as you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Questions, feedback or a problem with a House? Write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

legal.draftNotice: Placeholder structure – every section must be written and legally reviewed before launch.

terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses Simpulo – hosts and guests alike.

role.title: Role of Simpulo
role.body: Simpulo is a platform that connects people who want to share a place. Simpulo is not an accommodation provider, travel agent or party to the rental agreement – the accommodation is booked by the host with a third party.

hosts.title: Hosts' obligations
hosts.body: Hosts describe their House honestly, only open Houses they actually intend to book, keep everyone in the House informed, and book the accommodation they locked. Hosts are responsible for complying with local rules on short-term stays.

payments.title: Payments & fees
payments.body: Guests pay their share of the locked accommodation price through Simpulo. Fees, the payment provider, payout timing to the host and currency conversion are described here.

cancellations.title: Cancellations & refunds
cancellations.hostCancels: If the host cancels, every guest gets a full refund of their share.
cancellations.guestLeaves: If a guest leaves, their share is forfeited – unless the spot is refilled by someone else.
cancellations.bookingProof: The host uploads proof of the booking within 48 hours after everyone has paid. Without proof, guests are refunded.

prohibited.title: Prohibited content
prohibited.body: Houses are about sharing a place, not selling something. Not allowed:
prohibited.courses: Selling courses, coaching, trading signals or other products to people in the House.
prohibited.commercial: Commercial listings disguised as Houses – hotels, hostels, agencies or resellers.
prohibited.other: Illegal, hateful, sexual or misleading content and fake profiles.

safety.title: Safety & reporting
safety.body: Users can block and report other users and Houses at any time. Simpulo reviews reports and may hide content, suspend accounts or cooperate with authorities. In an emergency, always contact local emergency services first.

deletion.title: Account deletion
deletion.body: You can delete your account in Settings at any time. Open payments, active Houses and legal retention obligations may delay the deletion of some data.

policy.title: Cancellation
policy.description: When you get your money back on Simpulo: before the crew is complete, after paying, and when the host cancels.
policy.intro: Simple rules, the same for every House.
policy.draft: Draft – the legal review of these rules is still open.
policy.short: Cancellation: free until the crew is complete. After paying, only by handing your spot to the waitlist (everything back but the Simpulo fee). Full refund if the host cancels or doesn't confirm the booking in 48h.

beforeComplete.title: Before the crew is complete
beforeComplete.body: Withdraw your request or leave your spot any time, for free. Nothing is paid before the crew is complete and the place is chosen.

afterPayment.title: After you paid
afterPayment.body: You can leave by handing your spot to the next person on the waitlist. Once they take it, you get everything back except the Simpulo fee.

withoutTransfer.title: Nobody on the waitlist
withoutTransfer.body: If you leave after paying and nobody takes your spot, there's no refund – the crew has booked the place counting on you.

hostCancels.title: The host cancels or doesn't book
